setup: Wu Ming test Battle 1 (control): [Lns]MatiSparks attacks with 5 FC2 Lv. 10.0 Infantry led by Gatot into a 2-Infantry garrison (1 T9 + 1 T10, shown Lv. 9.5) reported under [JOE]MatiBlizzard with the defending Infantry hero slot vacant; attacker wins on turn 69 (Gatot Skill 2).

turn_inference.cadence: King's Bestowal (Gatot Skill 2) triggers each time Gatot's Infantry attacks; the attacker fields a single Infantry unit, so one trigger per turn
assumptions: Skill Details shows attacker Gatot Skill 2 (King's Bestowal) Triggered = 69.

Per the established Gatot-instrument convention (MuellerAlpaca_Gatot_v4/v5, Lab Rat, FarSeerGatot_v3) and Martin's instruction for this set, the King's Bestowal trigger count is the exact number of turns until the battle ended.

stats_capture.notes: Left (attacker) column of the Stat Bonuses panel; all 12 rows visible. Identical in every independently captured battle (Battles 1-4).

hero_skills.name: Golden Guard
hero_skills.effect: Increases Gatot's Infantry Defense by 6%/12%/18%/24%/30% at Lv 1-5; this report does not show the skill level.

hero_skills.name: King's Bestowal
hero_skills.effect: Each time Gatot's Infantry attacks, grants them a Shield equal to Attack x 6%/12%/18%/24%/30% (Lv 1-5) for 1 turn; skill level not shown. Trigger count is this battle's turn clock.

hero_skills.name: Royal Legion
hero_skills.effect: Reduces enemy Attack by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25% at Lv 1-5; skill level not shown.

stats_capture.notes: Right (defender) column; all 12 rows visible. See suspicion: the header names MatiBlizzard but these values equal MatiLife's Battle 3/4 panel on 10 rows and are 171.7 lower on Infantry Attack and Defense.

notes: Source: E:/WOS/Screeenshots/WuMingTests.pdf, page 1, left column (slide heading 'Battle 1: Control - no Wu Ming'); screens: Battle Overview, Troop Power Comparison, Stat Bonuses, Skill Details with the attacker participant card.

Battle location X:743 Y:493 (report banner). The attacker, its troops, its Stat Bonuses and the battle location are the same in all six Wu Ming battles; the defender always totals 2 Infantry, power loss -116, shown as one combined 'Lv. 9.5' icon.

Attacker troops: Troop Power Comparison shows one Infantry icon 'Lv. 10.0' x5 with a red crystal badge '2', recorded as FC2 T10 (FC-badge convention of the Alpaca 'FC1 Lv 1.0' files). FC2 is below FC3, so Crystal Shield (the first Infantry chance proc) is not unlocked.

Defender troops: wos_sim/troop_catalog.py TIER_POWER gives T9 = 50 and T10 = 66, so the only integer-tier pair with average Lv 9.5 and total power 116 is 1 T9 + 1 T10 Infantry. Battle 4's Defender panel shows the split: [JOE]MatiLife 1 troop (power -50, T9) and [JOE]MatiBlizzard 1 troop (power -66, T10). The per-player split is not shown in this battle.

Skill Details: attacker Gatot (hero card Lv. 71) Skill 1 Triggered 1, Skill 2 (King's Bestowal) Triggered 69, Skill 3 Triggered 1, kills '-'. The defender side reads 'Infantry Hero: Vacant', so no defending hero skill fired.
Gatot Skill 2 = 69: the battle ended on turn 69. This is the no-Wu-Ming control for the series (B2 113, B3 130, B4 141, B5 146, B6 118).
Outcome: attacker 0 losses, 0 injured, 5 survivors; defender 0 losses, 2 injured, 0 survivors. The attacker participant card (Skill Details footer) shows kills 2 = defender losses 0 + injured 2.

SUSPICION - confirm with Martin before using this battle as the baseline: the header names [JOE]MatiBlizzard (X:743 Y:494, same avatar as Battle 2), but the defender Stat Bonuses match the MatiLife-led panels of Battles 3/4 on 10 of 12 rows (every Lancer and Marksman row, Infantry Lethality 114.4, Infantry Health 113.6) and sit exactly 171.7 below them on Infantry Attack (179.5 vs 351.2) and Infantry Defense (164.9 vs 336.6), while differing from MatiBlizzard-led Battle 2 on every row. Either the game applied MatiLife's stats to the hero-less garrison, or this panel screenshot comes from another report.
Stat Bonuses colouring in this layout is per row (green = the higher value), not a fixed own/enemy column colour; left column = attacker, right column = defender, matching the report's sides.
Joiner flags: the per-player Defender panel was not captured; per Martin, no Wu Ming was used by either defending player in this battle.
Type 1 (deterministic): Infantry only, T9-T10 with at most FC2 (no Crystal procs unlocked); Gatot's and Wu Ming's skills are fixed-effect or fixed-cadence (no chance procs).
